description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMongoSnapshotAdapter' that implements the 'SnapshotAdapter' interface for handling JSON-serializable entities with MongoDB. It provides methods for converting snapshot entities to and from JSON and BSON formats, with hooks for customization.

classes.name: AbstractMongoSnapshotAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class for MongoDB snapshot adaptation of JSON-serializable entities, providing conversion methods between JSON and BSON formats, with hooks for customization.

methods.description: Reconstructs a JSON-serializable entity from a snapshot offer or selected snapshot.

methods.name: convertToJson
methods.description: Converts a JSON-serializable entity to its JSON representation.

methods.description: Converts raw snapshot data to a JSON-serializable entity, handling BSON conversion.

methods.description: Converts raw snapshot entity to JSON object, expecting BsonValue.
